datasets.name: eventstreams
datasets.description: Wikimedia EventStreams, every change to every Wikimedia wiki as Server-Sent Events.

datasets.name: landing_live_batches
datasets.description: Sanitized NDJSON micro-batches, one file per stream and flush, never rewritten.

datasets.name: kafka_live_events
datasets.description: Sanitized live events on Kafka, Avro values registered in the schema registry (full).

datasets.name: mediawiki_history_dump
datasets.description: MediaWiki history dump (all revision, page and user events since 2001), TSV bz2.

datasets.name: pageview_complete_dump
datasets.description: Per-article daily pageviews by access type, human (user agent) traffic only.

datasets.name: wikidata_sitelinks_dump
datasets.description: Wikidata item to site page mapping (wb_items_per_site table dump).

datasets.name: bronze_live_events
datasets.description: Sanitized live events flattened to one row per event, as delivered (duplicates kept).

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: EventStreams event id (meta.id), unique per event.

columns.name: event_dt
columns.description: Event time in UTC (meta.dt).

columns.name: stream
columns.description: Source stream (mediawiki.recentchange, revision-create or page-create).

columns.name: wiki
columns.description: Wiki database name, for example urwiki.

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: recentchange type (edit, new, log, categorize) or the stream kind.

columns.name: namespace
columns.description: MediaWiki namespace number; 0 is the article namespace.

columns.name: page_id
columns.description: Page id when the stream carries it.

columns.name: page_title
columns.description: Page title, kept only for namespace 0 and never for log events.

columns.name: rev_id
columns.description: Revision id when the stream carries it.

columns.name: is_bot
columns.description: True when the edit is flagged as made by a bot.

columns.name: is_redirect
columns.description: True when the page is a redirect (page-create and revision-create only).

columns.name: length_new
columns.description: Page length in bytes after the change.

columns.name: editor_hash
columns.description: Salted hash of the editor for distinct counts; never published.

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Landing batch file the row was loaded from (lineage and idempotency key).

columns.name: ingested_at
columns.description: UTC time the batch was loaded into bronze.

datasets.name: gold_live_activity
datasets.description: Live activity per wiki in 15-minute event-time windows; late events counted apart.

columns.description: Start of the 15-minute event-time window (UTC).

columns.name: wiki
columns.description: Wiki database name.

columns.name: events
columns.description: On-time events in the window.

columns.description: Late events (silver flag) whose window had already been reported.

columns.name: new_articles
columns.description: Non-bot, non-redirect article creations (page-create stream).

datasets.name: gold_coverage_lag
datasets.description: Coverage lag per item and language, the core metric (docs/method.md).

columns.name: item_id
columns.description: Wikidata item number.

columns.name: wiki
columns.description: Language edition (wiki database name).

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Creation time of this language's article.

columns.name: first_created_at
columns.description: Earliest creation time of the item's article in the reference set.

columns.name: languages
columns.description: Reference-set languages with an eligible article for the item.

columns.name: lag_seconds
columns.description: created_at minus first_created_at in seconds.

columns.name: is_first
columns.description: True when this language created the item's first article (ties all count).

columns.name: reference_set
columns.description: The language set the first article is taken from (slice20, or all after the backfill).

columns.name: depth_ratio
columns.description: This language's current article size divided by the first article's (coverage depth).

datasets.name: gold_language_lag
datasets.description: Per language, items covered, items created first and median coverage lag.

columns.name: wiki
columns.description: Language edition.

columns.name: items_covered
columns.description: Reference items with an eligible article in this language.

columns.name: items_first
columns.description: Items this language covered first.

columns.name: items_followed
columns.description: Multi-language items this language covered after another.

columns.name: median_lag_days
columns.description: Median coverage lag in days over the followed items.

columns.name: items_in_reference
columns.description: Distinct items in the reference set.

columns.name: median_depth_ratio
columns.description: Median coverage depth (article size relative to the first language) over followed items.

columns.name: reference_set
columns.description: The language set coverage is measured against (slice20 or all).
